Watches and Wonders Shanghai, the official program now available

Richemont today announced the official program for the upcoming edition of Watches and Wonders Shanghai, bringing together its Maisons for a week of presentations, panels, and client events in the city.

The program includes novelties across watchmaking, high jewellery, and accessories, alongside a public exhibition tracing the craft behind the Maisons' most complicated timepieces.

Retail partners from across the region are expected to attend, with dedicated days for press, collectors, and clients of the Maisons.
